name: Early childhood education and care
what: Hold provider and service approvals under the national quality framework from the state regulator, be assessed and rated, and be approved by the Commonwealth to receive Child Care Subsidy.

layers.who: State education regulator (under the national law)
Commonwealth education department (Child Care Subsidy approval)

basis.source: Health care and social assistance industry (industry information)
basis.quote: Child care services must follow the National Quality Framework .

issues.what: The national quality framework is applied differently by state regulators.

evidence.source: A path to universal early childhood education and care (volume 1)
evidence.quote: even though the NQF has been in place for more than a decade, aspects of the regulatory system are inconsistent between jurisdictions.

issues.what: Early childhood teachers register state by state under differing requirements.

evidence.source: A path to universal early childhood education and care (volume 1)
evidence.quote: Teacher registration requirements for ECTs across jurisdictions are inconsistent, which risks limiting the work opportunities for ECTs who move across jurisdictions
